Shortcut \ensuremath{\rightarrow} overlay on screen & 5--39 ms \\
Shortcut \ensuremath{\rightarrow} screenshot frozen & 109--338 ms \\
Shortcut \ensuremath{\rightarrow} finished crop (including a cold round after 15 s idle) & 228--519 ms across all measured runs \\

Time to first token (varies a great deal with provider load) & 0.7 s with a lightweight Gemini model through the backend in one run; 3 s to 20 s in other runs, including a period when the provider returned \textquotedbl{}high demand\textquotedbl{} errors, which the app shows as a retryable error \\
Desktop app memory at idle (private) & about 183 MB in total (app about 167 MB, native helper 16 MB); before the optimisations about 397 MB (app about 270 MB with GPU acceleration, PowerShell helper about 127 MB) \\
Desktop idle CPU & 0.1--0.3 \% \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
}

Interpretation: the client-side work (capture, OCR, upload) takes well under a second; almost all waiting is model inference at the provider, which varies with load. Streaming and a per-stage timing line make that visible instead of hiding it.
